reason: I'd rather move a property sale lump sum through my own bank's NRI desk than hand it to a company I found on a scroll. The free CA call is a nice touch, but I'd just watch more YouTube and ask my bank first.
objection: I don't know REPAIHUB and I'm not sure about the tax side in India and Canada. A mistake on a lump sum this size is expensive, and I don't trust a new name with it without seeing real proof.
would_change_my_mind: Verified reviews from people who moved a property-sale lump sum, a CA I can check independently, and my own Indian bank confirming they accept this paperwork and the partner bank.
